english.note: Use this all-purpose choice for a turning understood as a junction or place where a road branches, especially in directions.
This is the all-purpose everyday choice for a road junction or a road-based crossing point, but not a river or railway crossing.
This is the all-purpose everyday choice for a road or street junction.
Use this for an ordinary road junction when its exact cross shape is not important.
